In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the simple enhancement models may be applied to CO2 absorption into amine solutions if a good kinetic model is used, and if short contact times are encountered.

the simple pseudo-first-order enhancement factor models based on the film, penetration or the surface renewal model may be used with confidence for CO2 absorption in the short contact time region and with an accurate kinetic model.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enhancement factor models are not suitable for analyzing pilot data with short contact times and accurate kinetic model.
the enhancement factor models are not applicable for long contact times, but for short contact times, such as in the experiments used for this work, the simple models are applicable.
the simple enhancement models are sufficient in many cases, but if the reaction is very slow, the discretized penetration or the Danckwert’s models should be preferred.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the simple enhancement models are sufficient to model CO2 absorption into amines in the presence of reaction and that the more complex models may not be necessary.
the enhancement factor models are applicable for analyzing pilot data, provided that the kinetic model is accurate.
the simple enhancement models based on the pseudo-first order reaction approximation may be used for analyzing experimental data and for process design and scale up.
